## The 2026 Bundibugyo virus disease outbreak in the
## Democratic Republic of the Congo

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="31%"}
![](../figures/bvd-insp-sitreps.png){height="330px"
fig-alt="A situation report page from the DRC national public health
institute, in French, with cumulative confirmed cases, deaths, isolation
occupancy, recoveries and suspected cases in boxes."}
:::
::: {.column width="35%"}
![](../figures/bvd-outbreak-streams.png){height="330px"
fig-alt="Posterior densities for cumulative infections, one curve per data
stream and one for the joint fit, which sits inside the spread of the
single-stream fits."}
:::
::: {.column width="34%"}
![](../figures/bvd-rt-over-time.png){height="330px"
fig-alt="Posterior reproduction number trajectories over the established
outbreak, with most of the mass between 1.5 and 2."}
:::
::::

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="55%"}
- One renewal model over the suspected, confirmed, death, export and
  bed-occupancy counts, fitted together
- The situation reports are French PDFs. Agents read them and digitise
  the epidemic curve
- It refits on every push and tags a release with the draws, 105 of them by
  10 August
:::
::: {.column width="45%"}
- Mooncake differentiates all of it. Enzyme matches Mooncake to 4e-15 on a
  single stream and cannot compile the joint
- Over 30,000 lines of Julia for one outbreak, most of it written by
  agents
:::
::::

::: {.attribution}
[BVDOutbreakSize](https://github.com/epiforecasts/BVDOutbreakSize), the
`bvd_joint` arguments and the Julia line count read 2026-08-12 from the
clone at commit `90df658d`, whose 121 tags include 105 `results-*` draws
releases · figures from the WHO
collaboratory talk of 10 June 2026, fitted to data as of 7 June ·
situation reports from
[insp.cd](https://insp.cd/ebola-17eme-epidemie/) · the Enzyme comparison is
[BVDOutbreakSize#445][bvd445], open at 2026-08-12.
:::
